name: glom-continuity
description: Local project checkpoints and reviewable handoffs across AI assistants.

interface.shortDescription: Resume a project without losing its next step.
interface.longDescription: Save project checkpoints, check referenced files, and exchange explicit handoffs. Local project memory; no model calls, cloud sync or completion authority. Host integration has separate requirements.
defaultPrompt: Save a checkpoint for this project.
Restore this project's goal and next step.
Prepare a reviewed handoff to another assistant.
